title: Food, Medicine & Health
subject: English Language
objectives: Name foods that are good for the body
Identify things that harm the body

blocks.text: Things That Are Good for the Body

blocks.caption: Food and medicine are good for the body.

blocks.md:
Food is good for the body. Examples:

- Rice
- Yam
- Fruits
- Vegetables (like ewedu and okra)
- Garri
- Fufu
- Beans

Beans contain **protein**, which helps us grow well and strong.

Medicine is also good for the body when we are ill. Examples:

- Worm medicine
- Malaria medicine like **ACT** (Anti-malarial Combination Therapy)

blocks.text: Things That Are NOT Good for the Body

blocks.md:
Some things are dangerous to the body:

- **Sand and chalk** (do not eat them!)
- **Cigarettes** — they destroy the lungs
- **Hard drugs** like cocaine, heroin, and marijuana — they destroy lives
- **Alcohol** — not good for young people's bodies
**Remember:** Eat healthy food. Take medicine only when a doctor or parent gives it to you. Never touch cigarettes, drugs, or alcohol.

quiz.q: Which of these foods is good for the body?
quiz.explain: Rice is a healthy food for the body.
ACT stands for Anti-malarial Combination Therapy.

quiz.q: Which of these is a hard drug?
quiz.explain: Marijuana is a hard drug — never touch it.

quiz.q: Why is protein good for the body?
options: It makes you grow well and strong
quiz.explain: Protein helps the body grow well and strong.
